# Pull Request Template
--- 
⚠️ Note: This template does not apply to automated PRs (e.g. Dependabot).
---

> See section 2. Naming Conventions in `github-governance.md`
## Conventions Checker: PR/Branch

Format: `<issue-number>-<type>-<short-description>` 
Example: `23-feature-modularize-common-sh`

- [ ] Branch name follows the format above 
- [ ] PR title follows issue naming convention: `<type>: <short-description>`

- [ ] PR description includes `Closes #<issue-number>` to link the PR to the corresponding issue (e.g. `Closes #45`)


## Convention Checker: Issue
Format: `<type>: <short-description>`
Example: `feature: modularize common.sh`
Allowed types: `business-problem`, `epic`, `feature`, `bug`, `documentation`, `chore`

- [ ] Issue title follows the format above.

---
